card.name: Space before a duration number
card.fires_on: Mostly the blank space right after "for" or "until" that comes just before a number of weeks or months, as in contraception or infusion-duration instructions. Also fires inside a few brand names such as BEYFORTUS and Febuxostat.

modes.label: Space before duration
modes.description: The space after "for" or "until" that leads into a number of weeks, months or days after treatment.
modes.example: Advise females of reproductive potential to use effective contraception during treatment and for<< >>7 months following the last dose of PER

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: A middle piece of a drug name, such as ORT in BEYFORTUS or ux in Febuxostat.
modes.example: BEYF<<ORT>>US may be administered prior to or during
